Individual Measurement: Stitching of shirts shall be carried out strictly as per the individual measurements of each pers onnel, which shall be taken by the successful bidder/vendor at the designated location. 2. Sample Approval: The successful bidder shall stitch 03 (three) shirts as samples and submit them for inspection/ap proval before undertaking bulk stitching. Bulk stitching shall be commenced only after acceptance o f the samples by the authorized representative of the Unit. 3. Quality and Workmanship: The shirts shall be stitched as per the approved specifications, measurements, pattern and required quality standards. Any defective or improperly stitched item shall be rectified/re-stitched by the bid der at no additional cost. 4. Completion Period: The entire stitching work shall be completed within 45 days from the date of commencement o f work/receipt of measurements. 5. Billing Cycle: The billing cycle shall be monthly. Bills shall be submitted on a monthly basis for the quantity of work duly completed, inspected and accepted by the authorized representative. 6. ATC Certificate: The successful bidder shall submit an ATC Acceptance Certificate, duly signed and stamped, con firming acceptance of all the terms and conditions stipulated in the ATC. Material to be Supplied by the Unit: The shirt/Angola cloth, buttons, stitch buttons, buckram and sewing thread required for sti tching shall be provided by the Unit to the successful bidder. The bidder shall use only the materi als supplied by the Unit for the stitching work and shall not claim any additional cost towards these materials. 7. Acceptance of ATC: Submission of bid shall be deemed to constitute acceptance of all the ATC terms and conditions. Th e bidder shall comply with all the stipulated requirements without any deviation.
